basic_info.description: Situated in a prime NOPA location, 1949 Hayes is the top full floor flat in a stunning Edwardian 3-unit building. Walking into the gracious entry you are greeted by brand new oak hardwood floors that run throughout. The property is technically a 3BR/1BA but because of the scale there are many options for bedrooms, media rooms or home offices, please refer to the floor plan. The kitchen has granite counters, maple cabinets and gas range, with adjoining full laundry room. The kitchen leads to the living-dining room with fireplace and balcony with south views over a beautiful, deep common yard. The floorplan is very flexible based on your lifestyle- see agent. There is one remodeled split bath, common to these properties. Deeded storage room and independent parking space included. Note the low dues of $280. On the same block as Karma Cafe, close to Haight-Ashbury, the panhandle and Golden Gate Park, this is a phenomenal value.
